name: funroute-web
description: The FunRoute workbench: a CodeMirror editor and a structure view on the language server.

scripts.build: rm -f dist/chunk-*.js && esbuild src/app.ts src/lsp.ts src/editor.ts src/contract.ts src/runner.ts src/canvas.ts --bundle --splitting --format=esm --target=es2022 --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name] --chunk-names=chunk-[hash] --legal-comments=none --minify
